turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hi! Thanks for booking. How old are you?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm twenty-six. Honestly, I'm a bit nervous about all this paperwork.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: That's completely normal. We'll take it step by step. Are you single or in a relationship?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Single. No kids, just me and my cat.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Great. Tell me about work. What do you earn?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I work at a warehouse, and I made about nineteen thousand last year. That's my only income.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Does your job give you any health or dental benefits?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, the warehouse doesn't offer dental, so I don't have any.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Okay. When did you file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I did my return last year, for 2025. It was pretty quick.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thanks. Are you a Canadian citizen?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I was born here in Toronto.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Before we finish, is there anything you'd like to correct from earlier?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, going back to my pay, sorry, it's actually twenty-one thousand a year, since my hours went up. That's still my only income.
